column1: # group_of.tsv — a camera's source and the group the platform puts it in (ADR 0053: `placement.group_by: {field: source,
# cut_at: host}` of vms.subsystem.yaml, read by the source field's `schemes`; `w2cplatform.spec.url_host`), read by
# The group is the HOST the source names, in one spelling: neither the scheme nor the port is part of it; lower case, no
# trailing dot; an IP as written once (IPv6 unbracketed, RFC 5952, no zone; IPv4-mapped as IPv4); a percent-escape in a
# host is not decoded. (none): no group. With the grouping declared, the only sources without a group that are taken
# are the `none` ones (driverpack://file/…); a host nobody can tell is refused at write, 400 (ADR 0053).
# This is the course's seed of the table, until «Паритет» replaces it with the table shared with the product.
# Columns, tab-separated: the source; its group, or (none); `refused` when a write of it is refused — by the field's
# `secret_in` and address rules, or because no host can be told in it — and a readable host is its group all the same
# (refusing a login is the field's, grouping is group_by's); a note.
